title: TILSWALL IW260 20V Cordless Impact Driver

comparisons.notes: Official brand store. Same 20V brushless impact driver with 260Nm torque and 0-3600 RPM, 4Ah battery and 2A charger in the description. Shopify product data shows available=true, SKU USPTWID01, single variant at $99.99. Free shipping over $49. Match by ASIN B0FGJSWK4L and model IW260; Woot In the Box lists the driver only.

amazon_match_notes: ASIN B0FGJSWK4L verified by checker as the IW260 kit; Amazon list higher so Amazon bar does not block. Caveat: Woot In the Box lists only the driver while ASIN describes 4Ah battery and charger kit.
writeup: Tilswall's IW260 20V brushless cordless impact driver is $59.99 new on Woot, with about five left and a five-per-customer limit. Tilswall's own store sells the same IW260 (260Nm torque, 0-3600 RPM, SKU USPTWID01) for $99.99 in stock, so this clears about 40% below that live price. The listing matches by ASIN and model; Woot's In the Box line names only the driver itself.
